title: broken_promise_v1: promises and whether they were kept
description: One item per promise event. broken: the due point passed without fulfilment, it was fulfilled only in part, or the promisor made it impossible. pending: not yet due and still possible. kept: fulfilled in full and on time. Listing kept promises is optional. Identity fields for the shuffle comparison: promisor, promisee, promise_event, status.

reason.description: Free text for presentation only. Not scored.
